Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (pilot scope + procurement path)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our end and the asks we discussed so we have a clean record and next steps:

Call highlights:
- Pilot scope: 3-week pilot with up to 5k concurrent monthly users, modeled at ~150M tokens/month.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency at 95th percentile, PII-safe inference, deterministic output for key workflows, and unit cost.
- Stakeholders confirmed on the call: Rajiv Menon (VP Data) = economic sponsor; Arjun Patel (Legal) & procurement@medixhealth.com for contracting/purchase order.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
1) We can offer a pilot commercial package: 20% one-time pilot credit (applied to first invoice) + temporary SLA of 99.5% during pilot.
2) We need to surface SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and data retention controls to Arjun and procurement.
3) Procurement timing note: if you need a PO, please let us know target date so we align billing/setup.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), SLA-exception-request.docx (draft language), pilot-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement/legal contacts & target PO date (can loop Arjun/procurement).
- If OK, I’ll start the internal approval for the 20% pilot credit and SLA exception; Ben will help with commercial sign-off, Laura (revenue ops) will review financial impact, and Mina in Security will validate the temporary SLA and DPA needs.

Would love confirmation on timelines by end of week so we can get a doc back to you. Happy to set a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Dylan
